name: Quizgecko
tagline: Quizgecko turns text, documents, or URLs into multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer quizzes using AI. Instructional designers and trainers use it to build knowledge checks for e-learning courses without writing questions by hand, then export the results to common LMS formats.
